posts.author: Kotononicals
posts.body:
I have been recently migrating from MV to 2k3 and I hear there are limitations to the engine's animation capabilities and I have a few questions.
In a part of the game I'm currently working on, there are statues where this goddess princess character acts as a save point and a guide (think hint man from earthbound, where you can talk to them for hints on what to do next). I'm wanting the sprite of this goddess character to be roughly four tiles tall, possibly five, and swaying left to right and transparency fading in and out on loop. Is this possible in the engine? As well as idle animations in the overworld or in towns/interiors, and maybe even battle idle animations, would that be possible and if so, how? Eventually, this goddess character manifests into a playable character human form, where the save points become these campfire sites. I'd want an animation where they rest there, all sitting by the campfire and talking about different relevant points at the current part of the story they are in. What are the true limitations of animation in 2k3's engine and are these examples possible?

posts.author: NessCH
posts.body: The width and height of RPG maker 2003 is 24x32 (I measured it with Asprite.) so making the character sprites taller is possible but you'll will have trials and error cuz I tried that once but the sprite got compressed and ended up blurry.

posts.author: Cherry
posts.body: You can do everything you said using pictures, at least outside of battle. In battle it will be a bit cumbersome and limited.

posts.author: Akkari
posts.body:
You can use Show Picture(I believe the OG has the animated Spritesheet option right? I use maniacs so I'm a little rusty on what the vanilla version uses) and Events which can use graphics from the upper layer of the tileset currently in use as well as normal character sprites.
Battle Idle animations should be easy I would think? since RM2k3 has 4 pages of 8 Pose Animations in addition to the weapon animation section. So that's 32 Pose Animations and 32 Weapon Animations per Animation2 slot(if you want more than 32 per character, I don't think you can change a characters animation sheet, so you'd need to make a second actor slot and then swap the party member out maybe? idk if that'd work tbh lol)
As for character idles on the overworld, you'd do what you do in other RPG Maker software and swap out the Character Graphic for your Idle Animations, although maybe there is an easier way of going about that I'm still learning alot tbf XD
